notes: οὐκ ὀλίγον is split under rule 2, each token keeping its own English word: ὀλίγον is not a negative able to carry the negation alone, so rules 41 and 59 do not empty the negator, and the litotes is two English words rather than the single word rules 39 and 45 require for a joined unit.
SBLGNT.ACT.14.28.v031 is a selected unit whose base reading the ASV translates, so no rule 97 note is owed.
